PATIENT/TEST INFORMATION:
Indication: Congestive heart failure.
Status: Inpatient
Height: 70 inch
Weight: 190 lb

MEASUREMENTS:
Left Ventricle - Ejection Fraction: 30% to 35%
Left Ventricle - Septal Wall Thickness: 1.2 cm

FINDINGS:
LEFT VENTRICLE: Moderately dilated LV cavity. Moderately depressed global left ventricular systolic function. No masses or thrombi are seen in the left ventricle.
RIGHT VENTRICLE: Normal RV chamber size and free wall motion.
AORTIC VALVE: Mildly thickened aortic valve leaflets. No aortic regurgitation is seen.
MITRAL VALVE: Mildly thickened mitral valve leaflets. Moderate (2+) mitral regurgitation is seen.
TRICUSPID VALVE: Mild tricuspid regurgitation. Moderate pulmonary artery systolic hypertension.
PERICARDIUM: No pericardial effusion.

CONCLUSIONS:
Moderately dilated left ventricle with moderate systolic dysfunction. Moderate mitral regurgitation. Moderate pulmonary hypertension.

PATIENT/TEST INFORMATION:
Indication: Aortic stenosis. Preoperative evaluation.
Status: Outpatient

MEASUREMENTS:
Aortic Valve - Peak Velocity: 4.2 m/sec
Aortic Valve - Mean Gradient: 42 mmHg
Aortic Valve - Valve Area: 0.9 cm2
Left Ventricle - Ejection Fraction: 60%

FINDINGS:
LEFT VENTRICLE: Normal cavity size. Normal regional and global left ventricular systolic function. There is moderate symmetric left ventricular hypertrophy.
AORTIC VALVE: Severely thickened/calcified aortic valve leaflets. Severe aortic valve stenosis. Trace aortic regurgitation.
MITRAL VALVE: Normal mitral valve leaflets. Trivial mitral regurgitation.
LEFT ATRIUM: Mild left atrial dilation.
PERICARDIUM: No pericardial effusion.

CONCLUSIONS:
Severe aortic stenosis with preserved left ventricular systolic function and moderate concentric hypertrophy.

PATIENT/TEST INFORMATION:
Indication: Endocarditis. Evaluate for vegetation.
Status: Inpatient

FINDINGS:
LEFT VENTRICLE: Normal cavity size and systolic function. Estimated ejection fraction 55-60%.
RIGHT VENTRICLE: Normal size and function.
AORTIC VALVE: A large mobile vegetation is seen on the aortic valve. Moderate to severe aortic regurgitation.
MITRAL VALVE: Structurally normal. No mitral regurgitation.
TRICUSPID VALVE: Normal. Physiologic tricuspid regurgitation.
PERICARDIUM: Trivial pericardial effusion, without hemodynamic significance.

CONCLUSIONS:
Large aortic valve vegetation consistent with endocarditis. Moderate to severe aortic regurgitation. Preserved biventricular systolic function.
